definition: Anéis de circuitos mágicos densos e interligados ao redor de um núcleo de energia, contidos numa bolha no oceano de energia branco-pálida da alma.

prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story / conceptual magical anatomy. Original landscape 3:2 illustration for Nihility tabletop RPG rulebook, a precise visual explanation of what a Skill looks like INSIDE a soul. The entire scene is submerged within a vast continuous OCEAN OF PALE WHITISH ENERGY, not physical water: soft milk-white and pearl-gray flowing energy currents extending beyond every edge, NO horizon, no ocean surface, no humanoid soul outline and no person. At the center a single translucent spherical bubble holds ONE Skill. Within that bubble is a compact intense WHITE ENERGY CORE, surrounded by several three-dimensional concentric/interlocking tilted RINGS made from densely inscribed magical circuits. Make each ring a substantial curved band with exceptionally intricate disciplined micro-calligraphy, fine repeated geometric circuit inscriptions and connected paths etched across its surface. The rings orbit the core at differing orientations, with meaningful gaps through which the core is visible; a clear engineered structure, like a complicated gyroscope of magical writing. Their outer extent fits entirely inside the bubble. The visible bubble membrane separates the finite Skill circuit from the continuous soul energy outside. Pale-white soul energy is fundamental; preserve separation through subtle cool gray-blue contours, warm ivory highlights, tonal modeling and controlled negative space, not saturated colored light. Core glow is localized, no bloom that washes out the writing. Richly painted traditional acrylic/gouache editorial fantasy illustration with selective extremely fine ink-like detail on the rings, tactile confident brushwork in the surrounding energy, excellent spatial readability and convincing curved perspective. Quiet, immense and intricate, not glossy CGI or a video-game skill icon. No panels, captions, recognizable alphabet, readable words, numerals, labels, logos, gold-purple grading, halos behind a humanoid, angel wings, feathers, eyeballs, divine face, starbursts, sparks or arbitrary decorative objects. The image must communicate: densely inscribed rings around an energy core, all inside a bubble suspended in the pale-white energy that is the soul. Soft edges integrate with a light book page. This is one illustrative Skill, not a chart of measured capacity.

Edit Image 1 (the pale soul-ocean and Skill bubble). Image 2 is ONLY a visual reference for luminous written magical rings and the relationship of golden inscriptions, blue energy and a bright golden core; do not copy its lettering or dark background. Preserve Image 1's composition: a full spherical bubble immersed in an immense ocean of pale whitish soul energy, no person and no humanoid silhouette, landscape 3:2. Transform the bands surrounding the core into RINGS OF MAGIC MADE OF DENSELY WRITTEN LIGHT, with rich cobalt/sapphire BLUE circuit bands and fine GOLDEN magical inscriptions running all the way around them. They should read as intricate three-dimensional magical circuit writing and coherent geometric paths suspended in energy, not solid metal hoops, jewelry, gears, hardware or engraved iron. Multiple tilted ring planes around the energy nucleus, gaps allow us to see through the circuit structure. The energy CORE must be strongly and unmistakably GOLDEN, a compact intensely radiant warm gold sphere with a few fine gold filaments reaching the inner circuits, preserving defined contours without bleaching everything white. Gold writing should be visibly repeated, dense and disciplined, like elaborate arcane calligraphy, no real words, no labels. Keep the soul ocean OUTSIDE THE BUBBLE PALE WHITE and pearl gray, with only a faint local reflection of gold and blue near the membrane, not a blue or gold ocean. The clear transparent bubble boundary remains visible and contains the entire Skill. Use the depth and luminosity relationship of reference Image 2 while keeping an original composed book illustration with painterly texture, clean readable large forms and selective fine details. No starburst filling the page, no explosions, purple lighting, wings, eyes, characters, dark space background, text boxes, logos, readable alphabet or added objects. The requested change is the appearance of the Skill: blue and gold energy-circuit rings and a very golden nucleus, surrounded by the existing white soul-energy ocean.

finalClarification: Os anéis são circuitos mágicos com linhas, ramificações e pontos de conexão; inscrições integram o circuito. A paleta azul e dourado e o núcleo dourado atendem à orientação visual do autor nesta ilustração.
